sponsors.description: Exeevo is a global cloud solutions provider for life sciences companies to improve how they interact with customers across their organization to provide exceptional experiences that drive commercial objectives and improve patients’ lives.

Viseven is a future-inspired global MarTech Services Provider for Pharma and Life Sciences industries with more than a decade of experience. Viseven offers innovative solutions for companies of different sizes and digital maturity levels by merging marketing and digital technology expertise with innovation and strategic capabilities. The company's solutions, products, and services are actively used by the TOP 100 Pharma and Life Sciences companies in more than 50 countries around the globe.

Vertical Search - Targeting & Segmentation more effective than ever before. AI-powered search engine for the healthcare market Are you looking for the right contacts in the market? Do you want to bring new treatments, drugs for rare diseases or medical devices to the doctors who are actively involved in your field? Then we have just the thing for you! Because there are no limits for our customizable search engine, no matter if pharma, medtech, digitalization or an unprecedented market transparency - everything is possible through our Vertical Search Health.

We are an independent agency that strives to deliver the best experiences for patients and healthcare professionals. We have some of the most experienced strategists, project managers, designers and developers in the industry. We work mostly with global pharmaceutical companies in the UK, Europe and the US, helping them embed excellent CX practice across the organisation. 75% of our team have worked at a senior level within the top 10 pharmaceutical companies, and we’ve all worked in other industries (software, recruitment, banking, FMCG, media, travel, automotive, not-for-profit and entertainment). Therefore, we draw on wide experience to bring you the best strategies and solutions for your project.

Ingemark is a technology company specializing in AI-driven solutions, with AssistCraft Suite as its flagship product. AssistCraft is an enterprise-grade AI multi-agent platform that enhances business operations by integrating seamlessly with company data and IT ecosystems. It offers multimodal AI chat capabilities, real-time data access, and regulatory compliance. With deep expertise in AI customization in the MedTech industry, Ingemark empowers global organizations to deploy scalable, secure, and intelligent AI assistants that optimize workflows and decision-making.

Digitas Health London is a modern marketing agency working with science-led clients to launch and develop health brands for sustained growth through digital-first experiences designed around the real needs of consumers, patients and health professionals.  
 Combining human insight with data-driven strategy, Digitas Health London helps brands show up where they can deliver genuine value. More than advertising, this is People Powered Health.

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Avalere Health is a global strategic partner, perfectly formed to solve the biggest challenges in health – at pace and at scale. We are united across the product lifecycle, uniquely positioned to understand every angle of life, health, and the human condition.

Helping great health and wellness brands win. Everybody is a digital marketing agency that connects people with brands that make life healthier. Through our unique mix of insights, ideas, activation and optimisation, we’re reimagining marketing to make better health and wellness choices more desirable and discoverable. We believe that great work comes from having a diverse group of people who feel happy and supported to be their best selves, so employee wellness is a top priority. With our hybrid working policies, wellness initiatives, growth opportunities, and benefits designed to make life healthier, we give our team the ability to shine.

Avatia is building the AI Commercial Operating Layer for Pharma — a coordinated workforce of specialized AI Co-workers that works across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Brand, Digital, Omnichannel, and field teams. Avatia helps pharma companies expand into new markets and segments, reach more HCPs, engage them with relevant and always-available support, and augment existing teams with more intelligence and execution capacity. By connecting knowledge, data, workflows, and HCP interactions, Avatia turns AI into real commercial capacity — helping pharma organizations serve more healthcare professionals, more effectively, at scale.
AI-based solution for perfect HCP & Customer journeys.

Onomi is the event-centric customer engagement solution for life sciences. It helps companies create personalized, compliant experiences that boost HCP & patient engagement. Covering all medical event needs – from omnichannel webinars & advisory boards to in-person congresses – Onomi integrates deeply with CRMs such as Veeva & Salesforce to make data collection & follow-up easier. With over 22 years of experience & trusted by 15 of the top 20 life science companies, Onomi creates engaging HCP experiences, measures real impact & is more cost-effective than traditional point solutions.

Health Relations is the online magazine of the German publisher Deutscher Ärzteverlag, providing high-quality editorial content on pharma and healthcare marketing. It addresses decision-makers and professionals from healthcare, pharma, and agencies, offering insights into campaigns, trends, and industry developments, closely aligned with the professional world of physicians.

My Medical Affairs (MyMA)provides you with one central place to keep up to date with all the upcoming events relevant to your medical affairs interests, from a plethora of organizations around the globe. Additionally, you can access on-demand content. MyMA curates the content relevant to your individual preferences, or you can search for events/content by keyword, topic, organization or author. Monthly email notifications will keep you on top of everything happening that month, and there is also a solution provider directory.

PM360 embraces diversity, gender equality, ideas, and innovation that advance bold ideas in pharmaceutical marketing. PM360 is the premier magazine for marketing decision-makers in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device industries. Published monthly, PM360 is the only journal that focuses on delivering the full spectrum of practical information necessary for product managers and pharma marketing professionals to succeed in the complex healthcare environment.

SciencePOD is specialises in creating digital content specifically designed to engage HCPs. We deliver clear, concise and compelling summarised highlights of medical and scientific content in text, infographic, podcast, video and AI-summary formats. Our content creation platform hosts a global community of over 600 medical and science writing professionals.
MEDtube is the largest social eLearning platform for 450,000+ professionals sharing 30,000+ videos, courses, images, documents and webinars.
